notes.title: Amazing color lead illustration art!!!
notes.notes:
All the fine arts have been redone, and the style of hand-painted color and lead illustration has been adopted, which is renamed "Time Traveler"(originally called "Lonely"), two different levels have been modified, changed some original game mechanisms and Fixed most bugs.

notes.title: Choice Story
notes.notes:
In the new update, the choice story mode is added, and players can skip the previous checkpoints to select the specific gateway experience. For example, when you feel that 10 levels are too difficult to pass temporarily, you can choose the game after 10 levels in the selection mode, or choose to go back to the previous level.
